title: leptorkis acuminata
intro: Leptorkis acuminata, commonly known as the "Indian Mast" or "Palmate-leaved Leptorkis", is a plant species that belongs to the family Zingiberaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic.
